title: fix(plugin-auth)!: an invited sign-up the audience posture admits receives the declared self-registration set, and is refused when that set cannot be resolved

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：开放注册或按邮箱域名放行的自建部署里，被邀请的人自己注册后，和普通注册者一样拿到管理员指定给自助注册者的那组权限；若那组权限不存在或已停用，被邀请者注册也会被明确拒绝并提示去修配置。
- 为什么做：执行维护者对本单的裁决：被邀请与未被邀请的自助注册者只用一条规则，授权和入组读同一个判断，补上被邀请者少一组权限的漏洞。
- 出错会怎样：权限组配置坏掉的部署里，原本靠邀请仍能进来的人会被拒，直到管理员改好配置或直接为其建账号；没有任何账号会被多给权限；回滚即撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么：这是收紧注册权限的改动，需要你本人审阅、批准并亲手合并。L1 ACCEPT 7076000414，全量测试 4107 通过，契约 PASS 7076202877（座位 7，head ffffab17）；两个小问题另立 #36355 跟进。

## What changes

**The rule (ruling A, card comment 7063136215).** Under `open`, and under `email_domain` for an address on `allowedEmailDomains`, a self-serve sign-up is admitted by the posture's own rule whether or not it also holds a pending invitation. It receives the declared `selfRegistrationPermissionSet`, and when that set cannot be resolved it is refused `403 AUTH_CONFIG_ERROR`, like an uninvited sign-up. The invitation no longer admits it with no grant.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/audience-posture.ts`: a module-private `isAdmittedByPostureRule(audience, email)` (`open`: every address; `email_domain`: an address on the allowlist; `invite_only` and an invalid posture: none). `decideAudienceAdmission` reads it after the social-provider address rule and before the invitation carve-out, answering `grantPermissionSet: true`; `isAdmittedByInvitationAlone` reads it to answer false for an address the rule admits. The grant path in `auth-manager-membership-admission.ts` is unchanged: a verdict that asks for the set already refuses `AUTH_CONFIG_ERROR` when `selfRegistrationSetResolvable` answers false, so the invited sign-up now meets that refusal. The module doc's invitation carve-out and fail-posture paragraphs state the exception.
- Unchanged (standing readings): under `invite_only` an invitation admits with no self-registration grant; under `email_domain` an off-allowlist sign-up an invitation admitted gets the account and no grant, whatever state the declared set is in; `admin_full_access` stays refused as the self-registration set; operator, bootstrap and provider creations.
- `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`: "admitted by its domain, invitation or not" now holds for the grant and the binding, and a new paragraph states the fail-closed refusal for both postures.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.self-registration-permission-set-reaches-invited-sign-ups.ts`: the ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry (the one spec path), registered by the changeset's `registered` marker.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/signup-organization-census-walled.dogfood.test.ts`: the open-posture invitee now holds the declared set on its first membership (the battery found the stale fixture).
- `.changeset/34971-allowlist-invite-grant.md`: BREAKING, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/spec`.

| posture | invited | address | before | after |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `invite_only` | yes (presented) | any | admit, no grant | same |
| `email_domain` | yes | on list | admit, NO grant, bound | admit, GRANT, bound |
| `email_domain` | yes | off list | admit, no grant, unbound until accept | same |
| `open` | yes | any | admit, NO grant, bound | admit, GRANT, bound |
| `open` / `email_domain` on list | no | | admit, grant, bound | same |
| the two changed rows, declared set unresolvable | | | admitted ungranted | refused `AUTH_CONFIG_ERROR` (the narrowing) |

## Acceptance notes

- `boot-sign-in-reachability.ts` (outside this card's file surface) says `decideAudienceAdmission` short-circuits on `hasPendingInvitation` before the posture switch, admitting under every posture. It stays true of the switch; the posture-rule check now precedes the invitation, and under `open` / on-list `email_domain` with an unresolvable set an invitation no longer admits. Not edited here. Carried by #36355 (with the `self-hosting.mdx` open-posture half-clause, contract review 7076202877 N1 and N3).
- Dispatch and claim spell `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` (copied); the decision analysis 7062693710 suggested `yes (narrowing)` for a diff that widens who receives the set and narrows the unresolvable case. Left for the contract review.
- The dispatch asked for an ADR-0087 migration entry; #34969 and #35200 used `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` instead. This change registers a semantic entry, so `os migrate meta` and the upgrade guide carry the notice.
